card.name: Dose thresholds and matching amounts
card.fires_on: Words in dosing instructions that set a limit or match an amount, such as 'below' before a mg limit, 'equal' before a volume, or the gap before a cell-count threshold. Mostly in dosage and administration sections.

modes.label: Count thresholds
modes.description: The blank space just before a cell-count cutoff in a dose-adjustment table.

modes.label: Limit or match words
modes.description: Words like below, match, equal or to that introduce a limit or a matching amount.
modes.example: Withdraw an<< equal>> volume of 5% Dextrose

modes.label: Duration phrases
modes.description: The unit of time after a minimum number in a treatment-length rule.
modes.example: continue treatment for at least 7<< days>> after both neutropenia and clinical symptoms
